CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2588 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53. Bus nonce: 5e940b010facff08129f97ba59a89a4f. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53` or `Fix review: blocked 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 5e940b010facff08129f97ba59a89a4f`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2588 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2588-5e940b01`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review of PR #2588 (the roster PR-B, branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr, title: roster(r10): register the Lean flow study groups, fly-ins and carries (R10-ROSTER-OPS)) at head 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53. Head moved since the earlier brief (50cb5ebe4 to 618810c1e); treat this as a fresh review of this head and read the PR body first.
Verify with the finder's harness, not the fixer's:
(1) Roster diff: `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53)...618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53 -- dev/programme/rosters/` (three-dot, never two-dot). List every group added or changed and confirm the body's counts of them against that diff, by running the count rather than quoting it.
(2) Every group added or changed is well-formed per carry_audit's schema (open tools/audit/carry_audit.py and read the schema it enforces; name the fields checked). Plant one malformed group as a control and show it refused; the unplanted tree is the null control.
(3) `python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py sweep` at this head reports 0 (print the output).
(4) `plan_table.py` (find it under tools/ with git ls-files) renders the roster at this head without error; show the exit code and the group count it prints.
(5) ## Red checks answers every red check-run at this head, read from the check-runs API per commit (not `gh pr checks`). nightly-status and ci-ratchet grade main, not this branch; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT.
(6) `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53` is clean.
Mutation proof and null controls for every quantified claim; every body figure re-measured at this head.
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53` or `Fix review: blocked 618810c1e2d9d7a8a44d4b4296227a1d535e1b53 <class>: <reason>`.

Standing rule 19 applies to every observation. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
